walls.reference_basis: North-row top dimension chain on 1f_view.png (1240/2400/1300/1240/2400/1240/1300/2400/1240mm, header total 15000mm) contains an explicit dimension-line break/jog mark (double diagonal tick) exactly at the cumulative 4940mm point, which coincides with this partition's modeled x=4.94m centerline. The nine printed segment labels sum to only 14760mm, i.e. 240mm less than the stated 15000mm total; this missing 240mm is hidden at the two jog marks (this wall and the x=9.82m partition), consistent with wall-thickness zones the drafter chose not to letter individually. The per-wall share of that 240mm is not determinable from this evidence, so thickness is left unknown rather than assumed; the representative plane stays at the seed's x=4.94m (unchanged geometry).

walls.reference_basis: Same top dimension chain contains a second break/jog mark exactly at the cumulative 9820mm point, coinciding with this partition's modeled x=9.82m centerline. walls.reference_basis: Explicit 240 thickness callout with extension ticks spans the wall band on 1f_view.png near x~655-700 px, matching the measured solid gray fill width (~20px) at multiple clear locations along this facade (e.g. x=770-830 px, y=347-367 px). The overall 8000mm vertical dimension north extension tick (~y=343px) aligns with the OUTER (smaller-pixel-y) face of this band, and representative plane y=8.0m is the footprint outer boundary, so offset 0 (outer face) is taken as representative; the inner face is at offset -0.24m. Note: pixel-derived scale (~10.6mm/px from the 15000mm chain) gives ~213mm for the measured 20px band, reasonably consistent with the printed 240 label within drawing/measurement tolerance; the printed label value (240mm) is used as the persisted thickness.

agent_assumptions: Plan top edge = North, bottom edge = South, left = West, right = East (unchanged from seed).
Wall thickness ~0.24m generally per plan hatch/jamb annotations; modeled as zero-thickness representative planes at wall centerlines/faces as previously established; not globally revised this pass.

F1 north-row partitions at x=4.94m and x=9.82m are confirmed this pass to sit exactly at dimension-chain break/jog points where 240mm of the stated 15000mm total is omitted from the printed labels; representative planes are kept unchanged (seed values) since the per-wall split of that 240mm is not evidenced.

A separate west-margin vs east-margin vertical dimension-chain conflict for the F1 corridor partitions (y=3/y=5) was found in a prior step this pass: west chain (3000/250/1500/250/3000=8000mm) closes exactly to the 8000mm footprint; east chain (2940/340/1200/340/2940=7760mm) does not (-240mm residual) and gives a different flank reading (340 vs 250mm). This was recorded as a textual finding; a structured wall_references entry for that boundary was attempted but rejected by the tool as a partial multi-room shared-wall contact, so it is documented here in notes instead, with representative planes left unchanged.
unresolved: F1 partitions at x=4.94m and x=9.82m: individual thickness/offset unresolved; only the aggregate 240mm gap across both jogs is evidenced.

F1 corridor partition walls (y=3/y=5): west-chain vs east-chain readings conflict (250mm vs 340mm flank, 8000mm vs 7760mm closure); true thickness/offset unresolved, geometry left at seed position; could not be persisted as a structured wall_reference because the corridor boundary is a partial multi-room shared wall unsupported by this tool.
The same east-margin chain also reads room heights as 2940mm vs the west chain's 3000mm; not further investigated this pass.

2f_view.png overlay calibration (~2.7% cross-axis disagreement), F1 north-row window span residuals, F1 east window sill/head height residual, and F2 ConfA/ConfB door split remain unresolved as carried over from the prior round.
Door swing direction/leaf count and room role labels remain unresolved as before.

Only these two F1 north-row partitions and the F1 corridor partitions were examined for the dimension-endpoint/reference-plane relationship this pass; all other interior and exterior wall faces on F1 and all of F2 remain unexamined for the same kind of chain-break ambiguity.

agent_assumptions: Plan top edge = North, bottom edge = South, left = West, right = East, consistent with seed.

Overlay calibration_001 for 1f_view.png/F1 (x: 420px=0m,1805px=15m; y: 336px=8m,1070px=0m; ~10.85-10.9mm/px both axes) is used as the checked registered frame; it shows a small 0.63% cross-axis scale disagreement (over the tool's 0.3% strict threshold) and an 8000mm chain residual of -39mm, both left as recorded calibration warnings rather than forced to zero.

F1 partitions at x=4.94m/x=9.82m and both facades (north y=8, west x=0) were re-documented as wall_references citing both original dimension-chain/pixel-band evidence and the new overlay cross-check; the two previously contradictory wall_dimensions entries (dim-north-240, dim-west-240), which duplicated a single 240mm thickness label as a same-wall chain with inconsistent side/direction labels (same_wall_endpoint_order finding), were removed rather than force-closed; thickness for those two facades stays at the directly observed 240mm.
F1 door and window openings (8 doors, 7 windows) were reviewed against 1f_view.png door swings and window hatch marks with coverage=complete for both kinds on F1; all matched with no findings.
unresolved: Individual thickness/offset split of the aggregate 240mm gap between the two F1 north-row partitions (x=4.94m, x=9.82m) remains unknown; only the combined jog-gap evidence exists.

The F1 corridor partition walls (y=3m/y=5m) still show a west-chain (3000/250/1500/250/3000=8000mm, closes exactly) vs east-chain (2940/340/1200/340/2940=7760mm, -240mm residual, differing 250mm vs 340mm flank reading) discrepancy inherited from the prior pass; this is a two-room shared boundary not representable by the current wall_references/move_shared_wall tooling without further evidence, so representative planes are left at the seed position and this is reported here rather than silently dropped.

F2 (2f_view.png) walls, partitions and openings were NOT re-examined or recalibrated this pass; only F1/1f_view.png received a checked overlay calibration and opening review this session. F2 fidelity, the previously-noted ~2.7% 2f_view cross-axis calibration disagreement, and the F2 ConfA/ConfB door split remain exactly as inherited from the seed, unresolved.

Only F1 north-row partitions, the two named F1 facades, and F1 door/window openings were checked against image evidence this pass; all other F1 interior partition faces (e.g. F1 south-row partitions at x=4.82/x=9.82 on the south side) were not independently re-verified for the same jog-mark ambiguity.
Door swing direction/leaf handedness and room role labels (S1/N2 etc.) were not verified against the drawing this pass.
